decisions.item: Scope cut: what ships (P0 only, P0 plus a chosen slice of P1, or more)
decisions.why: The 26 inventoried modules alone are about 3,300 dev-days; nothing else can be planned reliably until this is set
decisions.rec: P0 plus the P1 items of the showcase modules first

decisions.item: Approve or amend ADR-0018 (web stack and cookie session)
decisions.why: Every screen builds on it
decisions.rec: Approve; revisit when realtime needs a token endpoint

decisions.item: Privileged onboarding path (ADR): signup creating an organization
decisions.why: Needs one new sanctioned use of the privileged database path (ADR-0002 amendment)
decisions.rec: Approve with a narrow, audited onboarding function

decisions.item: Require email verification before first login?
decisions.why: Changes the signup flow and the login gate
decisions.rec: Allow login but show a banner until verified, as WaDesk's auto-verify setting allows

decisions.item: Signup open to anyone, or invite-only?
decisions.why: Decides whether the signup screen exists in production
decisions.rec: Open signup behind rate limits and email verification

decisions.item: Password policy (minimum length, complexity, maximum age)
decisions.why: Affects signup, reset and change-password validation
decisions.rec: Minimum 8 characters; keep the WaDesk policy fields for later

decisions.item: Roles seeded at signup
decisions.why: Defines what a new organization starts with
decisions.rec: Locked Admin plus an editable Agent role

decisions.item: Production mail provider (SMTP relay or an API provider)
decisions.why: Dev uses Mailpit; production needs a sender domain and deliverability setup
decisions.rec: Decide before the first real signup

decisions.item: D4: how production Admin roles receive new permission keys
decisions.why: The locked-role trigger blocks grants, so new keys do not reach existing Admin roles
decisions.rec: Kernel ADR plus a migration helper that unlocks, grants and relocks

decisions.item: D3: how worker jobs push to sockets
decisions.why: Realtime from background work needs a bridge
decisions.rec: @socket.io/redis-emitter in the kernel PR that adds the room registry

decisions.item: D5: platform super-admin actor kind
decisions.why: Admin-console modules cannot start without it
decisions.rec: Decide before the admin modules begin

decisions.item: D6: confirm Next.js 16 and next-intl
decisions.why: Chosen by default in ADR-0018
decisions.rec: Confirm

decisions.item: D7: GitHub settings (CODEOWNERS enforcement, up-to-date branches, merge queue)
decisions.why: Prevents conflicting merges between three people
decisions.rec: Turn on

decisions.item: Channel strategy: keep the unofficial WhatsApp QR engine or use the Cloud API only
decisions.why: WaDesk's own docs list ban risk; needs an ADR either way
decisions.rec: Decide before the channel core is built

decisions.item: Confirm domain codes and route names in assignment-input.json
decisions.why: Zones, migrations and permission keys use them
decisions.rec: Review once, then freeze

decisions.item: Get Vedant's and Punya's sign-off on the three-way split and add their GitHub handles
decisions.why: Changes to ownership need all three approvals
decisions.rec: Do this in one short call

decisions.item: Invite Vedant and Punya to the repository
decisions.why: They cannot see the private repo yet
decisions.rec: Settings, Collaborators

decisions.item: Confirm Geta allows its source on your personal GitHub account
decisions.why: The safety check flagged crm-platform going to a personal account
decisions.rec: Move to a geta-ai repository if the answer is no

decisions.item: Give each teammate their own licensed WaDesk copy at wadesk-reference/WaDesk
decisions.why: The source is licensed and is not in the repo
decisions.rec: Each person uses their own copy

decisions.item: Ticket for the Clerk login security issue
decisions.why: Any valid Clerk identity can create a user in any organization; no ADR covers it
decisions.rec: Fix or remove the exchange before production

decisions.item: Set a real CLERK_SECRET_KEY if staff login through Clerk is needed
decisions.why: The API refuses to boot without a value
decisions.rec: Keep the placeholder otherwise

decisions.item: Where daily work happens: wadesk-port or geta-ai/crm-platform
decisions.why: Code must not live in two places
decisions.rec: Pick one before feature work starts

decisions.item: Run the remaining inventory (Punya's 22 modules first)
decisions.why: Punya's tracker is empty until their modules are written
decisions.rec: Run in chunks of about 8 modules with one review pass
